devsam: Quick note — encountered parity bug between REST and SDK wrt boolean model config fields. REST returns `allow_unstable: false` but Python SDK mapping drops it.
charlie: can you paste exact responses?
devsam: repro below. super small.
```
# REST
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/rdl-beta/config | jq
# => { \"id\": \"rdl-beta\", \"max_tokens\": 1024, \"allow_unstable\": false, \"enable_kv_cache\": 0 }

# Python SDK
from redwood import ModelsClient
mc = ModelsClient()
mc.get_model_config(\"rdl-beta\")
# => {\"id\": \"rdl-beta\", \"maxTokens\": 1024 }  # allow_unstable and enable_kv_cache missing
```
maria.chen: I hit this in sampleapp where missing keys defaulted to enabling unstable features. Oops.
charlie: likely the common mapping/filter helper is filtering falsy values. Grep shows `if v:` in both python and node converters.
devsam: yep, `parsed = {k: v for k,v in resp.items() if v}` in python, node uses similar truthy check. That drops False and 0.
ci-bot: failing test: sampleapp/tests/test_feature_flags.py::test_disable_unstable_feature — 1 failed, logs: ci://artifacts/2070012330/logs.txt
charlie: proposed fix: treat None/null specially but preserve explicit false/0. In python use `if v is not None` and in node `if (v !== null && v !== undefined)`.
maria.chen: add regression tests for booleans and numeric flags (0/False). Also add a small integration test for SDK <-> mocked REST parity.
devsam: I'll open PR with change + tests + CHANGELOG note. Will add a quick sampleapp patch to guard `config.get('allowUnstable', False)` until SDK is fixed.
charlie: ping me on PR for fast review, I'll run local tests. Also we should add a docs callout: canonical field names and exact types in API reference so SDKs map deterministically.
devsam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1002 — includes tests and fix.
ci-bot: CI queued for sdk/pull/1002.
maria.chen: after merge, update quickstart sample that shows model config handling and add a one-liner in onboarding checklist: "verify SDK model config preserves explicit false/0 values".
devsam: created GH issue for wider scan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/160 — scan for truthy-filters-across-sdks
charlie: good catch. could be more parity surprises (e.g., retry_on_404, prefill_cache). Add to retro. :raised_hands:
